description: This file is a Perl module 'Git.pm' providing a comprehensive interface to the Git version control system. It includes constructors for repository objects, methods for executing Git commands, parsing configurations, handling credentials, and managing temporary files. The code facilitates interaction with Git through external command invocation, error handling, and various utility functions, serving as the main API layer for Git-related operations within a Perl application.

classes.name: Git::Error::Command
classes.description: Exception class representing errors from executing external Git commands, capturing the command line, exit status, and output for error handling.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new repository object, determining repository and working copy paths based on provided options or current directory.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Executes a specified Git command and returns its output, either as a string or array of lines.

methods.name: command_oneline
methods.description: Executes a Git command and returns only the first line of its output.

methods.name: command_output_pipe
methods.description: Runs a Git command and returns a filehandle to read its output.

methods.name: command_input_pipe
methods.description: Runs a Git command and returns a handle to write input to it.

methods.name: command_close_pipe
methods.description: Closes a pipe returned from command_output_pipe or command_input_pipe, checking for command success.

methods.name: command_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Creates bidirectional pipes to communicate with a Git subprocess, returning process ID and handles.

methods.name: command_close_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Closes bidirectional pipes and waits for the subprocess, throwing an error if it failed.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the current Git version string.

methods.name: exec_path
methods.description: Returns path to Git executables.

methods.name: html_path
methods.description: Returns path to Git HTML documentation.

methods.name: get_tz_offset
methods.description: Provides timezone offset string in +HHMM or -HHMM format for a given time or current time.

methods.name: get_record
methods.description: Reads a record from a filehandle delimited by a specified separator.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts the user for input, with special handling for password input.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns filesystem path to the Git repository.

methods.name: wc_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the working copy associated with the repository.

methods.name: wc_subdir
methods.description: Returns the subdirectory within the working copy being used.

methods.name: wc_chdir
methods.description: Changes the working directory subdirectory.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration variables from Git.

methods.name: config_bool
methods.description: Retrieves boolean configuration variables from Git.

methods.name: config_path
methods.description: Retrieves path configuration variables from Git.

methods.name: config_int
methods.description: Retrieves integer configuration variables from Git.

methods.name: config_regexp
methods.description: Retrieves configuration keys matching a regex from Git.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Determines whether color output should be used for a given operation.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Retrieves color escape sequences for Git UI.

methods.name: remote_refs
methods.description: Fetches remote repository references.

methods.name: ident
methods.description: Returns and parses identification info like author or committer.

methods.name: ident_person
methods.description: Returns name and email of an author or committer.

methods.name: hash_object
methods.description: Calculates SHA1 hash of a file considering its object type.

methods.name: hash_and_insert_object
methods.description: Hashes a file and adds it to the object database.

methods.name: cat_blob
methods.description: Outputs the content of a blob object to a filehandle.

methods.name: port_num
methods.description: Resolves port name or number.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential data from a filehandle.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential data to a filehandle.

methods.name: credential
methods.description: Invokes Git credential helper with specified operation.
